item.title: ‘Incredibly emotional’: Anaya Bangar gets CA nod for women’s cricket, eyes WBBL
item.summary: Anaya Bangar can play elite women's cricket in Australia starting March 2027. Cricket Australia confirmed her eligibility under its inclusion policy. This decision offers a pathway to the Women's Big Bash League. She must still earn a franchise contract through her performances. Her journey offers a potential path for transgender athletes in sports.
